SUBJECT: HOLIDAY ON MONDAY DUE TO HEAVY RAIN – DISTRICT COLLECTOR'S ORDER

Dear Parents,

Following the heavy rain alert issued by the Regional Meteorological Centre, Chennai, the District Collector of Salem has declared a holiday for all schools in the district. Accordingly, the school will remain closed on Monday, 16th November 2026.

Please note the following:
1. School buses and vans will not operate on Monday. The school office will also remain closed.
2. Students must not go near the Thirumanimutharu river, Mookaneri lake, flooded roads or open drains. Parents are requested to keep children indoors and away from electric poles and fallen wires.
3. The Class X Unit Test scheduled for Monday is postponed to Thursday, 19th November 2026.
4. Saturday, 28th November 2026 will be a compensatory working day and will follow the Monday timetable. Attendance on that day is compulsory.
5. Class teachers will share the day's homework on the class WhatsApp group by 10:00 AM on Monday.

For any emergency, please call the school helpline on 0427 244 7788 or the Transport In-charge Mr. S. Murugesan at +91 98765 41230.

Regards,
Mrs. R. Kalaiselvi
Principal

Fairlands, Salem – 636 016, Tamil Nadu

CIRCULAR REF: SVMHSS/SCI/TRIP/2026-27/014
DATE: 20th November 2026

SUBJECT: ONE-DAY EDUCATIONAL TRIP TO YERCAUD FOR CLASSES VI TO VIII

Dear Parents,

As part of our Environmental Science curriculum, a one-day educational trip to the Yercaud Botanical Garden has been arranged for students of Classes VI, VII and VIII on Friday, 11th December 2026.

Places to visit:
- Botanical Garden and Orchidarium, Yercaud
- Lady's Seat and Pagoda Point viewpoints
- A coffee estate walk with a talk on the Shevaroy Hills plantations

Trip details:
1. Timings: Students must report to the school by 6:45 AM. The buses will leave at 7:00 AM sharp and return to school by 6:30 PM. Parents are requested to pick up their wards from the main gate by 6:45 PM.
2. Trip Fee: Rs. 650 per student (covers bus travel, entry tickets, breakfast and lunch) must be paid through the school parent app or at the school office by Friday, 4th December 2026.
3. Consent Form: The signed consent form attached below must be returned to the class teacher by Wednesday, 2nd December 2026. Students without a signed form will not be taken on the trip.
4. Dress Code: Students should come in the school sports uniform with ID card, closed shoes and a sweater or jacket, as Yercaud will be cold in the morning.
5. What to bring: A water bottle, a small snack and a notebook. Mobile phones and cash over Rs. 100 are not allowed.
6. Health: The ghat road has 20 hairpin bends. Parents of children who suffer from travel sickness must inform the class teacher and send the prescribed medicine.

Trip Coordinator: Mr. K. Saravanan (Science Department) | Mobile: +91 98765 41231

Regards,
Mrs. R. Kalaiselvi
Principal

SUBJECT: HALF-YEARLY EXAMINATION SCHEDULE AND INSTRUCTIONS – CLASSES VI TO XII

Dear Parents,

The Half-Yearly Examinations for Classes VI to XII will commence on Monday, 14th December 2026 and conclude on Wednesday, 23rd December 2026. The subject-wise timetable is attached to this circular.

Important instructions:
1. Reporting Time: Students must be seated in their exam halls by 9:45 AM. Examinations will be held from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and students will be sent home at 1:15 PM.
2. Hall Ticket: Hall tickets will be issued on Friday, 11th December 2026. Students must carry the hall ticket every day. A duplicate hall ticket can be obtained from the office for Rs. 50.
3. Fee Clearance: Parents who have not paid the second term fee are requested to clear the dues on or before Saturday, 5th December 2026, so that hall tickets can be issued without delay.
4. Stationery: Students should bring their own pens, pencils, geometry box and a transparent pouch. Calculators and mobile phones are strictly not allowed in the exam hall.
5. Absence: A student who is absent due to illness must submit a medical certificate to the class teacher within 2 days of rejoining. There will be no re-examination.

Christmas holidays begin on Thursday, 24th December 2026, and school reopens on Monday, 4th January 2027.

For queries, contact the Examination Cell at exams@salemvalleyschool.in or 0427 244 7790.

Regards,
Mrs. R. Kalaiselvi
Principal

SUBJECT: 24th ANNUAL SPORTS DAY

Dear Parents,

We are happy to inform you that our 24th Annual Sports Day will be held on Saturday, 9th January 2027 at the School Ground, Fairlands, from 8:00 AM to 12:30 PM.

1. All students from LKG to Class XII must assemble in the school ground by 7:30 AM in their house T-shirts (Kaveri, Vaigai, Thamirabarani and Palar), white track pants and white canvas shoes.
2. House T-shirts are available at the school store for Rs. 220. Orders must be placed with the class teacher on or before Friday, 18th December 2026.
3. Parents are cordially invited. Please be seated in the visitors' gallery by 7:45 AM. Parking is available only at the side gate on Fairlands Main Road.
4. Students taking part in the march past must attend practice from 3:30 PM to 4:30 PM on all working days from Monday, 4th January 2027.
5. Breakfast will be served to all students in school. Please give your child a light meal at home before leaving.
6. In case of rain, the event will be moved to Saturday, 23rd January 2027.

For queries, please contact the Physical Education Teacher Mr. P. Senthil Kumar at +91 98765 41232.

Regards,
Mrs. R. Kalaiselvi
Principal

CIRCULAR NO: SVMHSS/CUL/2026-27/047

SUBJECT: SAMATHUVA PONGAL CELEBRATION AND PONGAL HOLIDAYS

Dear Parents,

Our school will celebrate Samathuva Pongal on Tuesday, 12th January 2027 in the School Courtyard from 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM. Students will cook sakkarai pongal in clay pots, draw kolams and take part in uriyadi, silambam and other traditional games.

1. Dress Code: Boys may wear a veshti and shirt, and girls may wear a pavadai-davani or saree. Students who do not have traditional dress may come in school uniform.
2. Contribution: Rs. 50 per student towards rice, jaggery, sugarcane and clay pots must be paid to the class teacher by Friday, 8th January 2027.
3. Kolam Competition: Students of Classes VI to XII who wish to take part must register with the Tamil Department by Thursday, 7th January 2027 and bring their own kolam powder.
4. Students will be sent home at 12:45 PM after the celebration. Buses will leave at 1:00 PM.
5. Pongal holidays are from Wednesday, 13th January 2027 to Sunday, 17th January 2027. School will reopen on Monday, 18th January 2027.

We wish all our families a happy and prosperous Pongal.

For details, contact the Head of the Tamil Department, Mrs. V. Meenakshi, at +91 98765 41233.

Regards,
Mrs. R. Kalaiselvi
Principal
